laws.rule: A traditional bul (a decree by traditional leadership) sets a curfew between midnight and 5am in the hamlets (suburbs) of Koror and Airai, to reduce petty crime linked to drug use. Smartraveller says foreigners are unlikely to be the target and that application is inconsistent, but recommends following local authorities and having a genuine reason to be in these areas during those hours.
